# MiniMax

[中文](../../../docs/03-厂商攻略/minimax.md) · [Human guide](../../../human/README.en.md)

The collected [MiniMax-M2.7 manual](../../../models/minimax/MiniMax-M2.7/README.en.md) covers the China-platform Chat Completions interface, native cURL, thinking output, streaming, multi-turn conversation, and a complete tool loop. Find the examples and official sources in the [feature index](../example-index.md).

The official lifecycle notice states that the M2.7 family stops accepting new users on **2026-10-19**, and its pay-as-you-go API retires on **2026-11-18**. From 10-19, old-name requests on M Plan / Token Plan route to M3.1 Flash Preview. [Lifecycle notice](https://platform.minimax.cn/docs/guides/models-intro)

| Purpose | Official entry |
|---|---|
| China-platform compatible interface and model parameters | [Chat Completions](https://platform.minimax.cn/docs/api-reference/text-chat-openai) |
| SDK, model identity, and complete tool-message history | [OpenAI SDK](https://platform.minimax.cn/docs/api-reference/text-openai-api) |
| Legacy native `/text/chatcompletion_v2` | [Text generation—deprecated](https://platform.minimax.cn/docs/api-reference/text-post) |
| API keys | [Official key management](https://platform.minimax.cn/console/access?tab=api-keys) |
| Costs | [Official pay-as-you-go pricing](https://platform.minimax.cn/docs/guides/pricing-paygo) |

The [M2.7 parameter guide](../../../models/minimax/MiniMax-M2.7/parameters.en.md) explains each field and maps it to actual files. Read evidence in two layers: [historical unified verification](../verification-status.md) currently has no unified-verifier report for this model, while [file-level status](../example-status.md) independently records real executions of original examples. The former's missing report does not mean the model was never called. Neither another vendor's results nor arbitrary parameter combinations can be inherited. [Evidence policy](../evidence-policy.md)
